desc: Notice of the 93rd AGM of the Members of the company will be held on Thursday, September 17, 2026 at 3.00 p.m. IST through VC and OAVM for F.Y. 2025-26.
93rd Annual Report along with Notice of Annual General Meeting (AGM) as per Regulation 34(1)(a) of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015
The Register of Member and Share Transfer of the company will remain close from Thursday September 10, 2026 to Thursday September 17, 2026 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of 93rd AGM.
The Register of Member and Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from Thursday, September 10, 2026 to Thursday, September 17, 2026 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of 93rd AGM.

This is to inform you that we have published newspaper advertisement regarding dispatch of Notice of 93rd AGM of the Company to be held on 17.09.2026, together with Annual Report for the F.Y. 2025-2026, remote e-voting information and e-voting at AGM, Book Closure and Record Date, in Free Press (English) and Navshakti (Marathi) on Wednesday, 26.08.2026.
